title: Lock-Free Pop Pipeline
goal: Order the atomic instructions in a lock-free stack pop routine.
hints: Read the next pointer from the current node before attempting the atomic swap.
The compare_exchange_weak parameters are expected value, new value, success ordering, and failure ordering.
explanation: To pop a node safely, you must first dereference `c` to read `(*c).next`. Next, call `compare_exchange_weak` to update the head pointer from `c` to `n`. Matching on the result allows the loop to exit on `Ok(_)` or update `c` to the newly loaded pointer `x` on `Err(x)`. Reordering the blocks breaks variable scope or creates syntax errors.
